rows.note: Use this for formally putting someone in prison, especially in legal or news contexts.

example.english: The court ordered the authorities to imprison him for five years.
example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 pun3 keoi5 sau1 gaam1 ng5 nin4

rows.note: Use this colloquial all-purpose choice when the focus is confining someone against their will, including non-literal confinement.

example.english: The lift seemed to imprison us for ten minutes.
example.jyutping: bou6 lip1 wan3 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 sing4 sap6 fan1 zung1
